title: Compare and choose
subject: Arabic
source: Seeded from arabic/y9 lesson 11 (Pupil PDF worksheet: compare and choose)
intro: Lesson 11: Comparing in the shop: cheaper, dearer, better. To understand how to compare clothes with the comparative and the superlative

questions.q: Compare two coats: the grey one is warmer than the blue one (دَافِئ → أَدْفَأُ).
questions.model: Teacher: دَافِئ on the أَفْعَلُ pattern is أَدْفَأُ; then مِنْ; then the other item: مِنَ الأَزْرَقِ.

questions.q: Compare and choose in the portal response box: three pairs of items with prices on the pupil PDF; write two comparisons for each pair and say which you would buy and why, using لٰكِنَّ once. Start: ... أَرْخَصُ مِنْ ...
questions.a: Six correct comparisons with مِنْ, three choices with reasons, لٰكِنَّ used correctly
questions.model: Teacher does pair 1: القَمِيصُ الأَبْيَضُ أَرْخَصُ مِنَ الأَزْرَقِ، لٰكِنَّ الأَزْرَقَ أَجْمَلُ. سَأَشْتَرِي الأَبْيَضَ لِأَنَّهُ أَرْخَصُ.

questions.q: write a superlative sentence about something in your home.
questions.a: For example: هٰذَا أَكْبَرُ كِتَابٍ فِي بَيْتِنَا

questions.q: Back to our ponder: cheaper or better?
questions.a: It depends on need and quality; argued with comparatives
